title: Exclusive basis.
bodyText: This part provides the exclusive jurisdictional basis for a court of the State of Hawaii to appoint a guardian or issue a protective order for an adult.
bodyHtml: [§551G-12]  Exclusive basis.  This part provides the exclusive jurisdictional basis for a court of the State of Hawaii to appoint a guardian or issue a protective order for an adult. [L 2012, c 236, pt of §1]
